name: National Livestock Mission: Entrepreneurship Development Scheme - Uttarakhand Livestock Development Board
benefit: Under this scheme, employment generation is promoted through entrepreneurship development in the small ruminants, poultry, piggery, and the fodder sector.
_eligibility_text: The applicant must belong to one of the following eligible categories: - Individual Entrepreneur - Self Help Group (SHG) - Farmer Producer Organization (FPO) - Farmers Cooperative (FCO) - Joint Liability Group (JLG) - Section 8 Company
